verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.79
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.79

verses.pali: 8. Apaṇṇakavagga
verses.english: 8.  Sure Bet

verses.pali: Vaṇijjasutta
verses.english: Business

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Venerable Sāriputta went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him:

verses.pali: “ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena midhekaccassa tādisāva vaṇijjā payuttā chedagāminī hoti?
verses.english: “Sir, what is the cause, what is the reason why for different people the same kind of business undertaking might fail,

verses.pali: Ko pana, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena midhekaccassa tādisāva vaṇijjā payuttā na yathādhippāyā hoti?
verses.english: while another doesn’t meet expectations,

verses.pali: Ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena midhekaccassa tādisāva vaṇijjā payuttā yathādhippāyā hoti?
verses.english: another meets expectations,

verses.pali: Ko pana, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena midhekaccassa tādisāva vaṇijjā payuttā parādhippāyā hotī”ti?
verses.english: and another exceeds expectations?”

verses.pali: “Idha, sāriputta, ekacco samaṇaṁ vā brāhmaṇaṁ vā upasaṅkamitvā pavāreti: ‘vadatu, bhante, paccayenā’ti. So yena pavāreti taṁ na deti.
verses.english: “Sāriputta, take a case where someone goes to an ascetic or brahmin and invites them to ask for what they need. But they fail to give what’s requested.

verses.pali: So ce tato cuto itthattaṁ āgacchati, so yaññadeva vaṇijjaṁ payojeti, sāssa hoti chedagāminī.
verses.english: When they’ve passed away from that life, if they’re reborn in this place, whatever business they undertake fails.

verses.pali: Idha pana, sāriputta, ekacco samaṇaṁ vā brāhmaṇaṁ vā upasaṅkamitvā pavāreti: ‘vadatu, bhante, paccayenā’ti. So yena pavāreti taṁ na yathādhippāyaṁ deti.
verses.english: Take a case where someone goes to an ascetic or brahmin and invites them to ask for what they need. They give what’s requested, but don’t meet expectations.

verses.pali: So ce tato cuto itthattaṁ āgacchati, so yaññadeva vaṇijjaṁ payojeti, sāssa na hoti yathādhippāyā.
verses.english: When they’ve passed away from that life, if they’re reborn in this place, whatever business they undertake doesn’t meet expectations.

verses.pali: Idha pana, sāriputta, ekacco samaṇaṁ vā brāhmaṇaṁ vā upasaṅkamitvā pavāreti: ‘vadatu, bhante, paccayenā’ti. So yena pavāreti taṁ yathādhippāyaṁ deti.
verses.english: Take a case where someone goes to an ascetic or brahmin and invites them to ask for what they need. They give what’s requested, meeting expectations.

verses.pali: So ce tato cuto itthattaṁ āgacchati, so yaññadeva vaṇijjaṁ payojeti, sāssa hoti yathādhippāyā.
verses.english: When they’ve passed away from that life, if they’re reborn in this place, whatever business they undertake meets expectations.

verses.pali: Idha, sāriputta, ekacco samaṇaṁ vā brāhmaṇaṁ vā upasaṅkamitvā pavāreti: ‘vadatu, bhante, paccayenā’ti. So yena pavāreti taṁ parādhippāyaṁ deti.
verses.english: Take a case where someone goes to an ascetic or brahmin and invites them to ask for what they need. They give what’s requested, exceeding expectations.

verses.pali: So ce tato cuto itthattaṁ āgacchati, so yaññadeva vaṇijjaṁ payojeti, sāssa hoti parādhippāyā.
verses.english: When they’ve passed away from that life, if they’re reborn in this place, whatever business they undertake exceeds expectations.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ kho, sāriputta, hetu ayaṁ paccayo, yena midhekaccassa tādisāva vaṇijjā payuttā chedagāminī hoti.
verses.english: This is the cause, this is the reason why for different people the same kind of business undertaking might fail,

verses.pali: Ayaṁ pana, sāriputta, hetu ayaṁ paccayo, yena midhekaccassa tādisāva vaṇijjā payuttā na yathādhippāyā hoti.
verses.english: while another doesn’t meet expectations,

verses.pali: Ayaṁ kho pana, sāriputta, hetu ayaṁ paccayo, yena midhekaccassa tādisāva vaṇijjā payuttā yathādhippāyā hoti.
verses.english: another meets expectations,

verses.pali: Ayaṁ pana, sāriputta, hetu ayaṁ paccayo, yena midhekaccassa tādisāva vaṇijjā payuttā parādhippāyā hotī”ti.
verses.english: and another exceeds expectations.”

verses.pali: Navamaṁ.
